questions.question: A relation in a relational database is also known as:
questions.explanation: In the relational model a relation is a table of rows (tuples) and columns (attributes). A schema is the relation's structure, not the relation itself.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about Big-O notation?

options.A: It represents the lower bound of an algorithm's runtime.
options.B: It represents the upper bound of an algorithm's runtime
options.C: It represents the average runtime of an algorithm.
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Big-O gives an asymptotic upper bound on growth (commonly used for worst-case runtime). The lower bound is Big-Omega, and a tight bound is Big-Theta.

questions.question: Which data type can store unstructured data in a column?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The RAW data type stores binary or byte-oriented (unstructured) data that is not interpreted by the database. Numeric and VARCHAR store structured numbers and text.

questions.question: Which of the following can be used to create an abstract class in the C++ programming language?

options.A: By using the pure virtual function in the class
options.B: By declaring a virtual function in the base class
options.C: By declaring the virtual keyword afterward the class declaration
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A class becomes abstract in C++ when it contains at least one pure virtual function (virtual void f() = 0;). Merely declaring a virtual function does not make it abstract.

questions.question: What kind of transmission medium is most appropriate to carry data in a computer network that is exposed to electrical interference?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Optical fiber carries light signals, so it is immune to electrical (electromagnetic) interference. UTP is the most susceptible to interference.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a server-side scripting language commonly used in web applications?
questions.explanation: Common server-side scripting languages are PHP, Python, Node.js (JavaScript), Ruby, etc. HTML and CSS are client-side markup/style languages and C++ is not a web scripting language, so none is correct.

questions.question: What is the term for the ability of a class to provide different implementations of a method based on the input parameters?
questions.explanation: Overloading means defining several methods with the same name but different parameter lists, with the version chosen by the arguments passed. Polymorphism is the broader idea; the specific term for choosing by input parameters is overloading.

questions.question: If we have not specified ASC or DESC after an SQL ORDER BY clause, which of the following is used by default?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: ORDER BY sorts in ascending order (ASC) by default when neither ASC nor DESC is specified.

questions.question:
What is the result of evaluating the postfix expression
10 5 + 60 6 / * 8 -

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: 10 5 + gives 15; 60 6 / gives 10; * gives 150; then 150 8 - gives 142. The final operator is missing in the printed paper, so it is restored here.

questions.question: On an Excel sheet the active cell is indicated by
questions.explanation: The active cell is shown with a dark, thick border. A dotted (moving) border marks copied/cut cells.

questions.question: To convert a Gray Code to its binary equivalent, which technique is commonly used?
questions.explanation: Binary bits are obtained from Gray code by keeping the MSB and XOR-ing each next Gray bit with the previously obtained binary bit. No subtraction, addition or division is involved.

questions.question: A storage area used to store data to compensate for the difference in speed at which the different units can handle data is
questions.explanation: A buffer temporarily holds data to smooth out the speed difference between devices (e.g. CPU and printer). An accumulator is a CPU register for arithmetic results.

questions.question: Which algorithm can be optimized to meet the timing deadlines and rate requirements of continuous media?
questions.explanation: EDF scheduling and SCAN-EDF (EDF with SCAN ordering for requests with equal deadlines) are both used to meet the deadlines and rate requirements of continuous media.

questions.question: Which among the followings is not a property of knowledge representation?
questions.explanation: The four properties of a knowledge representation system are representational adequacy, inferential adequacy, inferential efficiency and acquisitional efficiency. Representational verification is not one of them.

questions.question: What is the expanded form of TCP in TCP/IP?
questions.explanation: TCP stands for Transmission Control Protocol, the connection-oriented transport layer protocol.

questions.question: Which of the following is a disadvantage of using a distributed database system?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: With data replicated across sites, keeping copies consistent is difficult, so data inconsistency is a disadvantage. Improved accessibility is an advantage.

questions.question: The most common addressing technique employed by a CPU is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Direct, indirect and immediate addressing are all among the most commonly employed addressing techniques of a CPU, so more than one of the options is correct.

questions.question: In Boolean algebra the function of AND operator is
questions.explanation: In Boolean algebra AND is represented by multiplication (dot or *), while + represents OR.

questions.question: What is the purpose of SQL injection attacks?

options.A: To increase the performance of database queries

questions.explanation: SQL injection inserts malicious SQL into input fields to manipulate queries, commonly to bypass login/authentication or extract data. It never improves performance, security or encryption.

questions.question: Which language is better for writing structured code?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: PASCAL was designed specifically to teach and enforce structured programming. FORTRAN and early BASIC relied heavily on GOTO-based unstructured code.

questions.question: Which of the following programming medium is used by MobileMe to create the appearance of desktop application inside a browser?
questions.explanation: MobileMe used DHTML (HTML plus JavaScript, CSS and DOM scripting) to make web apps look and behave like desktop applications inside the browser. Plain HTML is static.

questions.question: What is the purpose of staffing level estimation in software project management?

options.A: To determine the number of hardware components required
options.B: To identify potential risks in the project
options.C: To allocate appropriate resources to the project
options.D: To estimate the maintenance costs of the software

questions.explanation: Staffing level estimation (e.g. Putnam/Norden's Rayleigh curve) determines how many people are needed over the project's phases so resources can be allocated properly. Risk identification is a separate risk-management activity.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a Search Engine available over the Internet ?
questions.explanation: DIKSHA is a Government of India digital learning platform for school education, not a search engine. Google, Bing and Yahoo are search engines.

questions.question: Let u = '1101', v = '0001', then uv = 11010001 and vu = 00011101. Using the given information, what is the identity element for the string?
questions.explanation: The empty string epsilon is the identity for concatenation: s.epsilon = epsilon.s = s. Inverses like u-1 do not exist in the free monoid of strings.

questions.question: Which data structure is mainly used for implementing the recursive algorithm?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Recursion is implemented with a stack (the call stack), which stores each call's activation record in LIFO order.
